tools.name: platform_overview
tools.description:
Tournaments running now, the next one to start, how many traders took part in tournaments in the last day and
    week, and the latest prize winners. Live data from buycrypt.com.

tools.name: list_tournaments
tools.description:
BuyCrypt trading tournaments: name, scoring (PNL in USDT, PMC in %, SCORE in points), coin, prize pool and its
    currency (USDT, Tour Pass, demo USDT), entry (free or a Tour Pass fee), dates and number of participants.

tools.name: get_tournament
tools.description:
One tournament: rules summary, prize pool, prizes by place and the standings (nick and score). For a running
    tournament the standings are provisional.

tools.name: leaderboard
tools.description:
BuyCrypt public leaderboard for one coin and period. Score = sum of the price moves (in % of entry price,
    signed by direction, no leverage, no size) caught by the trader's closed positions. Only traders who share their
    statistics are listed. api_bot = the account trades through the bot API.

tools.name: trader_profile
tools.description:
Public passport of one trader: rating 0-1000 and level, the five parts of the rating (result, risk, discipline,
    self-control, experience), trading style, win rate and volume of recorded demo positions. Only traders with a
    public profile page on buycrypt.com are shown.

tools.name: market_ticker
tools.description: Last price and 24h statistics of a USDT perpetual, the same prices BuyCrypt demo accounts trade at.

tools.name: demo_account
tools.description:
Balance, margin and open positions of YOUR BuyCrypt demo account (needs your bot API key in the
    X-BuyCrypt-Api-Key / X-BuyCrypt-Api-Secret headers; a read-only key is enough). Read-only: this server never
    places or cancels orders.

tools.name: demo_open_orders
tools.description: Open (not filled, not cancelled) orders of YOUR BuyCrypt demo account. Needs your bot API key.

tools.name: demo_recent_results
tools.description:
Recent realized results of YOUR BuyCrypt demo account (realized PnL and commissions, newest last), plus the
    total. Needs your bot API key.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "demo_account" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
